title: 918 Spyder in the Loft Late at Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Midnight Garage: a satin black Porsche 918 Spyder in the loft late at night, the city asleep outside, a light drizzle on the glass and the radio glowing low. 8 hours of deep brown noise, no music, for sleeping, studying, or blocking out the world while you work.

No music. No talking. No sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
